samples.behavior: UMD factory exports MagicString, Bundle and SourceMap. Edits caller-provided strings using a linked list of chunks, tracks original coordinates, concatenates sources and produces VLQ source maps. No evaluator, command execution, network request, credential access or persistence path was found.

Version-3 JSON debug map with original source code and coordinate mappings; not an executable script. Embedded sources implement the same text editing and map generation, plus the dependency codec decoder and debug-only Stats references.

execution_trace.load: Factory defines classes, the Base64 alphabet and warning state, selects a browser/Node Base64 helper with getBtoa(), assigns constructor exports and returns MagicString. It does not load runtime dependencies or invoke editing APIs automatically.
execution_trace.edit: append/prepend/update/overwrite/remove/move modify strings and chunk links. File names are used as source-map labels or manipulated as strings; no filesystem API is used.
execution_trace.encoding: generateDecodedMap walks chunks and records generated/original coordinates; SourceMap constructor delta-encodes these with Base64 VLQ. SourceMap.toUrl JSON-stringifies map data and uses window.btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(str))) or Buffer.from(str, utf-8).toString(base64) to return an inline data URL. No hidden executable content or decoding-to-evaluation chain.
execution_trace.callbacks: Replacement callbacks are supplied by callers, like normal String.replace behavior. RegExp.exec performs matching, not process execution.
execution_trace.dependency: Fetched sourcemap-codec 1.4.8; its published dist/sourcemap-codec.es.js is byte-identical to the embedded map source. Traced encode/decode VLQ loops, continuation/sign bits, source coordinate deltas and segment arrays. It has no further runtime dependencies.
execution_trace.debug_source: Fetched v0.26.7 src/utils/Stats.js, referenced only under DEBUG in original source. It records process.hrtime elapsed times and does not execute in the distribution bundle.
execution_trace.urls: Fetched GitHub project, PR 121 via GitHub API and MDN String.replace documentation. These are project/documentation references in diagnostics or comments, not network requests by the library.

label_explanation: Byte-identical published artifacts with behavior consistent with a text-editing library favor BENIGN. Incidental collection from a hostile parent package or a source labeling error could explain the external hostile labels; the originating container and deployment context were not supplied. No specific cause is asserted.
analysis_limits: Atomscan reports flow-graph-limited and flow-call-unavailable for the JS. Verdict uses full manual execution-path review, embedded-source/dependency inspection, upstream byte comparison and runtime smoke verification, rather than absence of detections.

trait_change.change: Extend source-map output-name recognition from CJS/ESM to UMD. Existing implementation diagnostic and source-map structure requirements remain required by the identity composite. No behavioral suppression or severity change.

verification.facts: Ran cleave facts on both complete samples; only RawScan text was emitted, with no decoded-string layers. Separately decoded the VLQ mappings and validated source index/line/column bounds.
verification.runtime: JavaScriptCore via osascript passed CommonJS registration, original-preserving text edits, Bundle concatenation, coordinate-map generation and ASCII/Unicode Base64 data URL generation. Node was unavailable.
verification.positive_control: Renamed UMD map retains source-map-implementation finding.
negative_controls: Changing declared output to another product rejects identity.
verification.final_scans: Reran atomscan for both samples. Direct local-rule cleave JSON confirms all six map findings, including source-map-implementation and sourcemap-output-name, are notable. JS findings are notable or lower; no suspicious or hostile findings.
